name: Chevalier
source:
Faction: Asmodian
Skill: Joker (Jookaa), Kajah of the Abyss (Shinen no Kaja), Incarnations of Darkness
Artist: [url=/s634]Nobushito[/url] 
Cards: [url=http://taimaninarena.wiki.fc2.com/upload_dir/t/taimaninarena/58e206384757713d9d36c19650c15484.png]AS 5 Stars[/url], [url=http://taimaninarena.wiki.fc2.com/upload_dir/t/taimaninarena/33f99f49fa7f7fa5a66028e538d0be18.png]AS 4 Stars EX[/url]
History:
Chevalier is a Demon and Viscount, a high ranking being in the Dark World. She is known far for her large library and vast knowledge.
Chevalier is a well-read, curious and smart woman. She tends to use literally works to express her feelings and addresses others with the name of fictional figures from the past. Chevalier also tends to use her own name when speaking.
She is non-confrontational, but afflicted with an extreme sense of intellectual curiosity, which can cause issues for others. Regardless of her odd behavior, she is not interested in conflict and only is merciless to those who interfere with her research. She always searches for new books and knowledge and is interested in humanity and Taimanin, as well as their role in the world. She holds no true alliance and often remains neutral or joins a side for her own purpose.
